QUOTE: `mbedtls_ct_compiler_opaque(x)` is the barrier. With assembly it is `asm volatile("" : "+r"(x))`, so the compiler cannot see through the value.
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer names mbedtls_ct_compiler_opaque as the barrier that stops the compiler seeing through a value, and it puts the definitions in library/constant_time_impl.h. It never says outright that this function sits in that file, but the placement is implied.
